messages:
deploy-bot: Runtime hold requested: pin runtime to v3.1.1 for all quantized model variants (llama3q-v1) due to long-sequence latency regressions seen in canary. Automated tests flagged p95 spikes.
Lucy: Saw the same in longseq-runner, 3 failures, KV-cache churn looks correlated. Proposing temporary pin back to 3.1.1 during tonight's change window.
Sam: Can we confirm SDK compatibility? Arjun, any incompatible client changes in SDK 1.8.0 that would block pin/unpin?
Arjun: SDK 1.8.0 introduces an optional header for kv-cache telemetry but it's backwards compatible. No forced client rollout required. Will add a compatibility log in 1.8.1 though.
Riley: ML infra reproducible. Repro steps: `python eval_longseq.py --model llama3q-v1 --quant 4bit --seq 8192` — tail latency spikes at the attention kernel on token 4096+. Quality delta negligible but latency is the blocker. Logs uploaded to S3: s3://redwood-eval/longseq/17645-llama3q.zip
Maya: If we proceed, ops plan: pin at change window with canary in us-west-2, monitor p50/p95/p99. Rollback plan: immediate unpin + route traffic to non-quant variant if p95 > 200ms for 3 consecutive minutes. I'll own the rollback.
Lucy: Change window: tonight 22:00-22:30 UTC. Estimated disruption: none if smoke passes. Sam to run canary and smoke.
Sam: I'll schedule `deploybot pin runtime --runtime v3.1.1 --env prod --scope quant-llama3q --window 22:00-22:30` and start canary at 21:30 in us-west-2. :eyes:
Jen: Please add an item for the public release notes: "Temporary runtime pin to v3.1.1 for quantized Llama3Q due to latency spikes on very long sequences; customers using long-sequence workloads may see fallback to non-quant variant."
Lucy: Decision: proceed with pin at 22:00 UTC. Notify status page if window extends beyond 22:45. :warning:
deploy-bot: Action scheduled: pin runtime -> v3.1.1 at 2026-03-20T22:00:00Z. Rollback command: `deploybot unpin runtime --runtime v3.1.2 --reason rollback` (manual trigger).
Sam: Canary started at 21:30 in us-west-2, running smoke now — no errors so far, p95 within expected bounds.
Arjun: I'll add a small SDK telemetry patch to emit compatibility warnings in 1.8.1 and open a PR.
Maya: Oncall monitoring in place, alert thresholds set (p95 > 200ms, error rate > 0.5%). I'll escalate immediately if triggered.
Lucy: Thanks all. After the window, paste smoke results here and I'll update the internal changelog + release notes section.
Sam: Smoke results: canary OK, no regressions in 15m sample. Proceeding with scheduled pin. :thumbsup:
Lucy: Closing the loop: pin applied, observing metrics. If anything changes we'll unpin and fallback. Keep this thread updated.
